context_conclusions: Rabbah bar Ulla supplies first substantive interpretation: impure slaughterer of ordinary food maintained at sacred purity; long knife avoids contact. Sacred slaughter prohibited initially due contact risk but valid post factum on certainty of no contact. These later qualifications cannot be silently omitted if initial all is expanded.
Exceptions for three incompetence categories remain unless observer condition; discussion explicitly questions referent of all and absence of speaker available for inquiry.

Further Abaye and Rava alternative Samaritan readings have objections marked kashya; do not present them as uncontested final interpretation. Rav Ashi new reading begins 3a:13; not fully read or adjudicated in this cohort.
